verdict.rationale: Productboard documents linking feedback to features, components and feature ideas, including automatic insight detection, and features can then be pushed into delivery tools such as GitHub issues. However, the evidence never shows a single-step 'convert this feedback into a new task or feature' action; it documents linking and association rather than direct conversion. Missing for 10: an explicit documented one-step conversion of feedback into a new feature or task, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the workflow.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can turn a customer feedback submission directly into an actionable task or project intention

citations.quote: Productboard automatically detects insights within feedback that can be linked to related feature ideas.
Associate feedback with users and companies, and connect it to features, components, and other product hierarchy entities.
Notes can be linked to features to quantify demand and inform prioritization.
Push features ready for development into GitHub as issues.
